preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 2000.
Each test case must have N, the number of integers in the sequence, between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A_i <= 10**9 for A_i in A)
preconditions.description: Each integer A_i in the sequence must be between 1 and 10^9.
The total sum of N across all test cases must not exceed 2,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N-1 integers for each test case.
Each integer in the output must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == min_insertions[i] for i in range(N - 1))
postconditions.description: The output integers must correspond to the minimum number of insertions required for each K from 2 to N.
